summary: This table presents the quarterly financial performance across various sectors for the periods ending December 31, 2025, September 30, 2025, and December 31, 2024. The sectors include Financial Services, Manufacturing, Energy, Utilities & Services, Retail, Communication, Hi-Tech, Life Sciences, and Others, with their respective contributions to total revenue expressed in percentages. The table also highlights year-over-year growth rates for each sector, showing a reported growth of 3.2% and a constant currency growth of 1.7%. Notably, Financial Services shows the highest contribution at 28.2% for December 31, 2025, while Others has the lowest at 2.4%. The data indicates varying growth trends across sectors, with Manufacturing and Hi-Tech showing significant year-over-year increases.
